sections.title: 1. Matter, Particle Nature & States of Matter

masteryZone.q: Which state of matter has the highest compressibility?
masteryZone.sol: Gases have the highest compressibility due to very weak intermolecular forces and large spaces between particles.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Bose-Einstein Condensate is formed by heating gas of high density.
masteryZone.sol: False. BEC is formed by cooling a gas of extremely low density to super low temperatures close to absolute zero.

masteryZone.q: The fourth state of matter is called ________.
masteryZone.sol: Plasma is the fourth state of matter, consisting of super-hot ionized gas particles.

masteryZone.q: The temperature of boiling water during vaporization:
masteryZone.sol: During boiling, the temperature remains constant at 100°C as all heat goes into latent heat of vaporization to break bonds.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Increasing humidity increases the rate of evaporation.
masteryZone.sol: False. Increasing humidity decreases the rate of evaporation because the air is already saturated with water vapor.

masteryZone.q: Which of the following is a colloid?
masteryZone.sol: Milk is a colloid (emulsion), showing the Tyndall effect. Salt/sugar water are true solutions, and sand in water is a suspension.

masteryZone.q: True or False: A compound can be separated into its constituents by physical filtration.
masteryZone.sol: False. A compound's constituents are chemically bonded and can only be separated by chemical or electrochemical reactions.

masteryZone.q: Which technique is used to separate petroleum fractions?
masteryZone.sol: Fractional distillation is used because the boiling points of petroleum fractions are close to each other (less than 25 K difference).

masteryZone.q: True or False: Crystallization is better than simple evaporation because it prevents decomposition of solids.
masteryZone.sol: True. Evaporation to dryness can cause decomposition or charring of solids, which crystallization avoids.
